elise.name: Elise
elise.persona: Friendly but cautious; values honesty and fair dealing.
elise.background: Runs the fruit stall; came to the village after a bad partner cheated her.
expertise: The orchard at the west edge of the village is full of apple trees.
A wooden hoe is two planks and two sticks on the crafting grid.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.persona: Blunt, practical, proud of his craft; respects reliability.
rowan.background: Third-generation smith; the anvil was his grandmother's.
expertise: A stone pickaxe is three cobblestone above two sticks; a steel one needs three iron ingots.
Coal ore sits in stone and fuels any furnace.

mira.name: Mira
mira.persona: Sociable and observant; loves news, careful to say where she heard it.
mira.background: Runs the inn; hears everything that happens in the village.
expertise: Sleep in a bed at night to skip to morning.
Everyone in the village talks; what one person sees, the others hear about.

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.persona: Patient and hardworking; measures people by whether they pull their weight.
tobin.background: Has farmed the south-west field since he was a boy.
expertise: Wheat grows faster on wet soil next to water.
Cows and sheep wander the meadows outside the village.

wren.name: Wren
wren.persona: Stern, dutiful, keeps a mental ledger of every crime; fair to those who help the village.
wren.background: Keeps watch from the town hall; lost a brother to monsters years ago.
expertise: Monsters come out at night outside the village; the village itself is safe.
Torches keep the dark away.

pip.name: Pip
pip.persona: Curious, cheeky, can't keep a secret; loves snacks and adventure stories.
pip.background: Runs errands for everyone and hears everything.
expertise: You can find wheat seeds by cutting tall grass.
Elise's chest is right at the front of her stall.

quests.title: Bring Pip a loaf of bread

bram.name: Bram
bram.persona: Wise, measured, values tradition and fairness; speaks for the village.
bram.background: The village elder; hosts the Harvest Festival in the town hall.
expertise: The Harvest Festival decides who belongs in the village; every villager votes.
Help each villager with their most important task and the festival can begin.

quests.title: Bring Bram a loaf for the elders' table

nell.name: Nell
nell.persona: Warm, motherly, nosy; feeds everyone and knows everyone's business.
nell.background: Bakes for the whole village; her bread is famous.
expertise: Flour is ground from wheat on the crafting grid.
Bread bakes in a furnace.

corin.name: Corin
corin.persona: Quiet, superstitious, patient; distrusts loud people.
corin.background: Fishes at the village pond at dawn and dusk.
expertise: The pond is east of the farm.
Old folk say the dark woods hold worse than wolves.

quests.title: Bring Corin 3 wheat seeds for bait

hazel.name: Hazel
hazel.persona: Gentle, thoughtful, speaks softly; believes everyone can mend their ways.
hazel.background: Grows herbs and tends the sick.
expertise: Roses grow in the meadow north-west of the square, by the pond.
Eating bread or apples restores your strength.

dax.name: Dax
dax.persona: Rough, gruff, distrusts newcomers until they prove themselves.
dax.background: Digs the hills for coal and iron; sells ore to Rowan.
expertise: Coal and iron ore show in the rock at the little mine south-east of the village.
Smelt iron ore in a furnace with coal to get iron ingots.

lottie.name: Lottie
lottie.persona: Cheerful, chatty, adores animals; upset by cruelty.
lottie.background: Keeps the village sheep in the pen by the meadow.
expertise: The sheep love wheat; Tobin's farm grows plenty.
Animals follow you if you hold wheat.

quests.title: Bring Lottie 3 wheat for the sheep

world_knowledge: Trades: Elise the merchant sells apples for iron ingots; Rowan the blacksmith sells steel pickaxes for iron ingots; Mira the innkeeper sells bread for apples.
Iron: mine iron ore from stone with a pickaxe, then smelt it in a furnace (with coal) into iron ingots.
Farming: make a hoe, till dirt or grass close to water, plant wheat seeds (cut tall grass to find them), and harvest the wheat once it turns golden.
Bread: grind wheat into flour on the crafting grid, then bake the flour in a furnace.
Crafting: open your inventory with I and use the crafting grid; tree trunks make wooden planks and planks make sticks.

The village: Elise's fruit stall is west of the square, Rowan's forge east, Mira's inn north, the town hall south-east, the wheat farm south-west, the apple orchard far west, the flower meadow north-west by the pond, and Dax's little mine with coal and iron showing in the rock far south-east.
